answer: To answer, a key posts 3 coins that burn on a fail or a duplicate hash. Burst sybils then pay N x 3 plus N original texts, while one honest key risks 3 once. The burn list is public beside pearl, so dummy accounts cannot hide the extra loss. Copies never enter the split on the cipher; expected profit falls as N grows, and one pass covers the 3-coin risk at the meadow.
